profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at Mid-States Distributing
profile.summary: Mid-level Full-Stack Software Developer with strong focus on web application development. Experienced in building, maintaining, and enhancing enterprise-level internal tools using modern PHP/Laravel backends, Vue.js (Vue 3), and Microsoft Power Platform solutions. Skilled in full software development lifecycle, from local development environments to cloud-based version control and deployment. I'm always willing to learn new techniques and always strive to get the job done with little oversight.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.locationName: Fort Worth, Texas, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained full-stack applications using Laravel PHP and Vue.js (Vue 3), delivering responsive, scalable web solutions for internal company tools and portals.
- Contributed to the ongoing maintenance and enhancement of key company services, including a tradeshow portal with features for exhibitor management, attendee registration, and real-time data synchronization.
-Implemented CRUD operations across multiple modules, ensuring data integrity, efficient querying, and secure user interactions for user directories, reporting dashboards, and administrative interfaces.
- Built and maintained user directory systems with advanced search, filtering, and role-based access controls to support internal collaboration and data management.
- Designed and optimized reports generation features, integrating data aggregation, export capabilities (PDF/Excel), and performance tuning for large datasets.
- Leveraged Microsoft Power Platform tools, including Power Automate flows for process automation and Power Apps for custom low-code interfaces integrated with backend systems.
Utilized Azure DevOps Repos (formerly Azure Repos) for version control, CI/CD pipelines, branching strategies, and collaborative code reviews.
- Managed local development environments with Herd (Laravel development environment) for rapid iteration, testing, and debugging.
- Collaborated closely with cross-functional teams to align technical solutions with business requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deploy updates with minimal downtime.

positions.title: Enterprise Programmer Analyst
positions.locationName: Las Cruces, New Mexico, United States
positions.description: Lead web application developer for several different apps at NMSU. I am responsible for development, deployment, task lists, maintenance, and support for said applications. I am familiar with the PHP framework Laravel alongwith associated web stack of Javascript (ES6), JQuery, HTML, CSS3, Oracle DB, and MySQL DB. Version control utilized was GitLab and deployment via TeamCity.

positions.title: Co-op Software Developer
positions.description: Project lead for the start of an overhaul of NMSU security access application. This application would improve upon design,functionality, and efficiency of requesting security access for all NMSU staff and faculty.Delegated other co-workers to perform various tasks such as documentation, mock-ups, prototypes, and page building.Languages such as PHP, HTML, CSS3, Javascript, Jquery, and Laravel were used for this project.

positions.title: Student Programmer
positions.description: Assist in maintaining several web applications dealing with student information. As a student I assisted in development and debugging of these applications. PHP, Laravel, JavaScript, and GitLab were utilized.

positions.title: Oracle DBA Intern
positions.description: My job duties included the monitoring of Oracle Database systems and applications such as oracle enterprise manager. I monitor Linux servers and maintain them by either applying patches or running commands to restart servers. Part of my internship I created a python script to do a health check on our production system/application to ensure critical parts of our system is working properly and fix any issues or warnings.

positions.title: Shift Manager
positions.description:
Supervise a group of 2-5 employees to maintain McDonalds standards of customer satisfaction and cleanliness.
Maintain sales records and labor costs.
Multitask between different roles and duties to assist team and store.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Assisted Emerging technology groups in presenting their tech to attendees in a concise fashion.
Collaborated with other volunteers to provide the best guest experience.
Assisted attendees with VR demos with VR setup and demo explanation.
